name: 777 HERO: The One Who Defies Time
storyline:
Two years ago, my older sister left home and never came back. One million sword drills, zero real combat experience..... A timid twenty-year-old swordswoman sets out on a journey carrying nothing but the pocket watch her sister gave her.

But... what's this? The watch starts talking to her. It turns out a goddess with the power to stop time was living inside that watch, and she nags. A LOT.... Ugh... Where will these two's adventure lead..?!
summary: 777 HERO: The One Who Defies Time is a pixel-art idle RPG that incorporates pachinko-style mechanics into combat. Players control a timid swordswoman who embarks on a journey with a talking pocket watch possessing time-stopping powers. By firing balls and hitting jackpots, players trigger RUSH modes, collect various gear and relics, and customize their build through a skill tree to defeat bosses.
